sources.snippet: The Qwen3-8B is a state-of-the-art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-8B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices.
